models.description: Heston at the stored model_version-2 joint SPX/VIX-index fit (DE + L-BFGS-B on 53 z-grid anchors and 4 VIX indices; repo Lewis engine)

notes: Every model is scored on the same quotes (the calibrator's OOS universe) with the same metrics and dense-grid checks.

Surfaces are fitted to alternate strikes, so their out-of-sample quotes are the strikes in between (an interpolation test); Heston's in-sample set is its calibration anchors, fitted jointly with the VIX index leg.
svi_cal is the arbitrage-free surface (butterfly and calendar certified on grids); svi has no calendar constraint and its calendar violations are counted in dense_grid.
Yahoo snapshots carry no quote time: part of every model's spread misses can be stale quotes rather than model error.
